survivors.claim: --json truncates at 64KB with exit 0 when stdout is a pipe (write-then-exit)
survivors.impact: A green exit carrying corrupt JSON on the exact invocation D7 enshrined in doctrine; latent at ~3x headroom against the live fleet.
survivors.evidence: 20-repo synthetic fleet: exit 0, stdout exactly 65536 bytes, JSON.parse 'Unexpected end of JSON input'. Live fleet emits 19416 bytes. Verbatim shape of the repo's recorded [host] gotcha from specs/20260816/01.

survivors.claim: unreadable ledger file crashes the whole fleet run with an undocumented exit code 1
survivors.impact: One bad file anywhere takes down every other repo's numbers; stdout empty.
survivors.evidence: Ledger path as a directory -> uncaught EISDIR at parseLedgerFile, exit 1, empty stdout. Same for chmod 000 (EACCES). Header documents only exit 0 and 2; host rules make an undocumented exit code hard.

survivors.claim: a .claude directory that cannot be listed renders as 'no ledger' at exit 0
survivors.impact: Silent absence — the exact lie-risk D4 names as this reader's biggest — produced by a swallow-to-empty catch.
survivors.evidence: chmod 0111 .claude on a repo whose ledger holds 3 rows: population row {"name":"xonly","rows":0,...}, human render 'rows=0 ... no ledger', exit 0.

survivors.claim: gate08 human render does not round-half-up at a .5 percentage boundary
survivors.impact: Contradicts the spec's pinned rounding rule on the figure the adoption gate is read from.
survivors.evidence: 23/40 = 0.575 exactly renders 57%, spec requires 58%. Root cause is scaling a non-dyadic ratio by 100 ((23/40)*100 === 57.49999999999999), NOT the 4dp intermediate: Math.round(23/40*100) is also 57. Second independent bug: 51/101 is truly 50.495% but renders 51% via the 4dp value.

survivors.claim: AC-20260820-05-17's oracle is bound to the wrong assert
survivors.impact: The AC names the section D7 rewrites; the tag landed on a neighbouring assert, so the coverage matrix credits a label rather than a check.
survivors.evidence: `spec-paths shared-for escape` serves '## Incident Policy' at line 51; `grep -n 'Incident Policy' tests/spec-paths.test.js` returned nothing. Equivalent protection existed via the generic mapped-section pin.

survivors.claim: config-existence check is a disclosed evasion of a standing repo-wide sweep
survivors.impact: Documents a technique that also defeats the sweep for a genuine config read; second shape-classifier evasion in this repo in one week.
survivors.evidence: Written as `claudeDir + '/spec.config.json'` so no line pairs path.join with the literal, dodging config-read.test.js AC-20260815-01-12, with a comment instructing editors not to tidy it. lib/host-config.js already defined configPathFor but never exported it.

survivors.claim: escape.md edit exceeds the spec's declared doctrine-delta scope
survivors.impact: Contracts says 'nothing else in either file changes'; the build also changed 'up to four ride together' to 'up to five'.
survivors.evidence: git diff 7bc2d57..HEAD -- spec/commands/escape.md shows the four->five hunk alongside the two sanctioned hunks. Necessary (D8 adds a fifth field to that call) and recorded in the build's deviations sidecar.
